rationale: The agent did identify the user via name and zip and viewed multiple orders, but it performed a return without first confirming the specific item or the action with the user, violating the policy to confirm every order-changing write. It also processed the refund to a gift card (payment_method_id=gift_card_7250692) despite the user requesting a refund to credit card and without establishing that a credit-card refund was not possible. The agent did not verify that the selected tablet was the more expensive one among the two, nor did it present options or seek confirmation on which item to return. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with the policy.
